focused.coverage: All 10 Phase1 cases plus the unchanged existing clock test, across all three browsers.

semantics.solver: The native module Worker performs the real calculations. A browser-only wrapper records requests and withholds its actual structured-cloned MessageEvents before the UI listener, then dispatches those same responses unchanged.
assertions: Start remains disabled while a manual Step 10s response is withheld.
Pause remains enabled while a clock advance is pending.
Pause makes Start available immediately and emits cancellation.
Releasing held progress, completion and cancellation acknowledgements cannot move the committed checkpoint.
After a real 1250ms interval, no additional worker requests have been sent.
Exported checkpoint equals the checkpoint before the held advance.
Explicit resume reaches 30s and exports the completed 30s checkpoint.
semantics.rendering: New regression intentionally uses the existing fallback fixture to isolate worker/UI control behavior; the unchanged existing clock test exercises the ordinary scene path.

toolchain.browserVersionSource: Installed Playwright browsers.json manifest. The focused run did not separately record browser.version(); no new browser was launched for this evidence.
